Common Questions

Have another question? Call us.

Insurance claims
Are estimates free?+

Yes. Call us at (305) 397-8911 to arrange an assessment. Have the vehicle’s year, make, model and a description of the damage ready.

Can you help with my insurance claim?+

Yes. We offer insurance claim assistance and work with claims from all insurance companies. Bring your insurer’s name and claim number; coverage, deductibles and payment are determined by your policy and insurer.

Can I choose my repair shop?+

Yes. Florida’s Department of Financial Services says you may select the shop that repairs your car after an accident. Discuss coverage, the estimate and any differences in cost with your insurer before authorizing work. Florida consumer guide

Do you work on my make and model?+

Yes. We work on all makes and models. Call us with your vehicle details so we can confirm the appropriate work, parts and any specialist services needed.

What warranty applies to my repair?+

Ask us for the written warranty terms for your specific repair before approving the work. We’ll discuss what is covered, how long coverage lasts and any exclusions.

Can you help with towing or a rental?+

Call us before arranging a tow so we can confirm where and when to bring the vehicle. Ask about current towing assistance and rental options; rental coverage depends on your insurance policy.

How long will my repair take?+

The timing depends on the damage, parts and the work required. We’ll discuss the expected schedule after assessing your vehicle. Call us directly for an update on an existing repair.

Your privacy

When you call or email the shop, your contact details and any photos are used to respond to your repair inquiry. An online request form, when available, also shares those details with the form provider and the shop. Do not send payment details, identification documents or unnecessary personal information.

Google Maps and Instagram have their own privacy policies. This site does not use advertising analytics. For questions about information sent to the shop, contact somicoachworks@gmail.com.
